title: Introduce minimal presubmit stager and dependency gating
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Presubmit pipeline feedback is slow for small changes and wasteful for dependency-only churn. This PR introduces a minimal 'presubmit stager' that quickly validates fast-path changes (docs, small TS/py edits, infra manifests) with lightweight, cached images, and a dependency-gating step that short-circuits expensive integration lanes for changes that only affect a curated dependency whitelist.

What this does (high-level):
- Adds a staged presubmit model: 'fast' (sub-2m feedback) and 'full' (existing matrix). The fast stage runs on a compact Go-based executor image and a tiny lint/test profile.
- Introduces a dependency-gate that uses a repo-level whitelist (.presubmit/dep-whitelist.txt). If commit touches only whitelisted files (lockfiles/toolchain manifests) and all changed deps are allowed, the full matrix is skipped.
- Extracts lint adapters into a small Go plugin (cmd/presubmit/lint-adapter) to reduce shell startup overhead and centralize exit codes; this reduces CI container churn and improves deterministic caching.
- Adds path-aware test slicing heuristics: changed paths map to a minimal test profile via declarative manifests in .presubmit/test-profiles/*.yaml.
- Adds lightweight devtool images and a toolchain prefetcher to warm caches for the fast lane.

Why now: Customer-facing teams reported a regression where small doc fixes triggered 20m full-matrix runs. This reduces median presubmit duration for small changes while preserving signal for broad changes.

Checklist:
- [x] Minimal fast stage implemented and wired into GitHub Actions composite workflow
- [x] Dependency whitelist mechanism and docs added
- [x] Unit and integration smoke jobs for the new Go plugin included
- [x] Migration guide for plugin authors added to docs/ci/presubmit-stager.md
- [x] Backwards-compatible: default config preserves full-matrix unless white/fast rules match

Compatibility notes: The new presubmit binaries are small Go programs; they replace bash entrypoints but expose the same exit semantics. Teams that relied on inline shell behavior should follow the migration guide to port custom checks.

Testing notes: Local smoke harness (tools/ci/smoke-run) was used to validate matrix short-circuiting. We ran a 48-hour sampling window against recent PRs to ensure no regression in false-negative rates (no regressions found in the sample).

Risks/Limitations: The dependency whitelist is an operational artifact — mistakes can cause skipped coverage. The pull request includes clear docs and a remediation step to opt into full-matrix if uncertain.

Related: ENG-2456 (presubmit latency), SUP-1203 (incident: noisy locks); see docs linked in the PR for migration steps.

release_notes:
- Introduce staged presubmit (fast + full) to reduce feedback time for small changes.
- Add dependency whitelist gate to avoid running full CI for allowed dep-only edits.
- Extract lint adapters into Go plugin to reduce CI startup overhead.
- Add path-aware minimal test profiles for faster presubmit runs.
